name: many-eyes-pilot3
about: Pilot 3: evolve-then-measure with the food covariate. 40 sim-min runs; vigilance is tallied only for the last 15 min (ethoFrom 1500) so brains have evolved ~25 min first. Each scan records the food level under the animal; the analysis reports a food-adjusted slope. Predators vs predator-removal control, caps x1.6, 4 paired replicates.
